nodes.summary: Let $\mu$ be a finite atomless measure. For every measurable set $s$ and every $t \in [0, \infty]$ with $t \le \mu(s)$, there is a measurable set $u \subseteq s$ with $\mu(u) = t$.
nodes.title: Sierpiński's theorem on atomless measures

nodes.summary: The restriction of an atomless measure to a measurable set is atomless.
nodes.title: Restriction of an atomless measure

nodes.summary: A measure $\mu$ on a measurable space is atomless when every measurable set $s$ with $\mu(s) > 0$ contains a measurable subset $t \subseteq s$ with $0 < \mu(t) < \mu(s)$.
nodes.title: Atomless measure
